ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (black) pixels dominate the surface area (~95%), with high-intensity (white) pixels appearing as sparse, high-contrast discrete features.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark contiguous region across both lobes. Sparse high-contrast white pixel clusters are scattered throughout, including ring-like geometric formations on the right lobe and multiple unaligned linear strokes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central indentation with a measured pixel angle of approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous trailing boundary exhibiting high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire linear extent.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward-sweeping curve fitting the trajectory from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and annular high-contrast white pixel clusters (rosettes) distributed across the ventral surface, with notable density on the right lobe distal region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) of varying pixel-length across the black pigmentation of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular high-intensity textural accumulations at both distal tips; dense network of intersecting white linear abrasions on both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive white 'O-shaped' and 'C-shaped' pixel configurations located on the medial-right lobe area.
